description: This file declares the HttpAuthHandlerNTLM class and its Factory for handling NTLM HTTP authentication, including platform-specific implementations and methods for creating and managing NTLM authentication handlers.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandlerNTLM
classes.description: Handles NTLM HTTP authentication, with platform-specific mechanisms and methods for generating auth tokens and handling challenges.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandlerNTLM::Factory
classes.description: Factory class for creating HttpAuthHandlerNTLM instances, with support for setting SSPI library on Windows.

methods.name: CreateAuthHandler
methods.description: Creates an NTLM authentication handler based on the challenge and context.

methods.name: set_sspi_library
methods.description: Sets the SSPI library to be used for NTLM authentication on Windows.

methods.name: NeedsIdentity
methods.description: Indicates if identity information is needed for authentication.

methods.name: AllowsDefaultCredentials
methods.description: Indicates if default credentials are allowed.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the handler with the challenge token and SSL info.

methods.name: GenerateAuthTokenImpl
methods.description: Generates the authentication token based on credentials and request.

methods.name: CreateSPN
methods.description: Creates an SPN string to identify the server for NTLM.
